## NumberTicker.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The number to display. The spring retargets whenever it changes.
- `format` :: Intl.NumberFormat options used to render the value (and the accessible name).
- `locale` :: Locale passed to Intl.NumberFormat, such as `"en-GB"` or `"de-DE"`.
- `form` :: `count` writes the formatted number; `slot` rolls each digit in its own column.
- `prefix` :: Text rendered immediately before the number, such as a currency symbol the formatter does not supply.
- `suffix` :: Text rendered immediately after the number, such as a unit.
- `startOnView` :: Waits until the ticker is in view before springing from zero to `value`.
